svg.title: TEGE page-device stencil
svg.desc: Layout devices for documents, drawn from 1990s manual and player's-guide conventions. STENCIL.svg holds interface parts; this file holds the devices a PAGE is built from.

g.inkscape:label: 00 Paper
g.text: How a page explains something. Interface parts live in STENCIL.svg. Both get copied, never redrawn.

g.inkscape:label: E1 Numbered callout ring

g.text: One line on what it does.
One line on what it does.
One line on what it does.
One line on what it does.
Numbers run down both sides. Legend repeats them in two columns.

g.inkscape:label: E2 Label outside pointing in
g.text: For two or three parts. Lighter than a full ring.

g.inkscape:label: E3 Arrow-chained sequence
g.text: Arrow carries the order. Use when the steps follow automatically
rather than being things the reader has to do.

g.inkscape:label: F1 Two-branch sidebar
g.text: If your project has a start scene:
What happens, in two or three lines. Say the outcome, not the
The other outcome. Both branches always get answered, so the
reader never has to guess which case they are in.
Thin rule, not a heavy box. It is an aside, not a warning.

g.inkscape:label: F2 Sub-article container
g.text: Hey! The gravity zone did nothing!
A digression that is worth a whole box, sitting inside a page about
something else. Rounded outline, own heading, no fill, so it reads
as a nested article rather than as an interruption.
Use it where a callout panel would be too loud and a paragraph
Nested article. Quieter than a panel, louder than a paragraph.

g.inkscape:label: F3 Term and description list
g.text: Press, drag, release. The ground you walk on.
No size, no material, no name asked for.
The same gesture. Anything you want the player
to bump into rather than fall off.
Not press-drag-release. The one tool on the rail
whose gesture is a different shape.
Term carries the verdict colour. Description stays italic and quiet.

g.inkscape:label: G1 Per-column header table
g.text: One hue per column. An eye tracks a column down a long chart without a ruler.

g.inkscape:label: G2 Multi-colour heading (optional)
g.text: Initial letters carry colour, the rest goes grey. Section openers only.
It gets hard to read below about 28px, so never use it on a subhead.

g.inkscape:label: G3 Page furniture
g.text: Publication name on the left, section on the right, page in a chip between them.
Swap the two outer items on facing pages so a spread reads outward.
